I’d like to know if any other couples have encountered this situation.

We went to the Misrad hapnim to recive a work visa for my partner (we are married), and I was given an appointment six months from now to get the A/5 visa. The issue is that the appointment is scheduled for 5 days *after* his B/1 visa expires, and I was told to submit an application to extend the visa one month before the current one runs out.

Does this mean I’ll have to pay for the extension again? Is this happening because there are no available appointments?
